tweets.text:
NEW: ICE officers in Kansas City arrested a previously deported Sureños gang member.
 
34y/o Mario Torrez-Lopez, of Mexico, admitted to being a member of the Sureños (Sur 13) gang—He has been deported from the U.S. four times: 2016, 2017, 2018 and 2022. 

He was first arrested and convicted on felony charges in 2012 in Indianapolis for resisting arrest and illegally passing a school bus.
 
“This individual repeatedly crossed the border, joined a violent gang while incarcerated, and built a track record of crime and disregard for the law…,He’s exactly the kind of threat we are determined to find, stop and remove from our communities.” —ICE @HSIKansasCity Special Agent in Charge Mark Zito.
 
Torrez-Lopez’s previous order of removal was reinstated—He will stay in ICE custody ahead of the upcoming court appearances.
 
The U.S. Attorney’s office for the District of Kansas is handling the prosecution.

📸 via ICE
